_doc: Labelled bot regression corpus (PLAN Phase 2 exit test: 'a labelled regression corpus exists and passes'). Every row goes through the REAL edge check (contract checkWire) and then the consumer precision pass. label=human must be counted; label=bot must be dropped, attributably (reason + detail). `expect` = the exact detail for rows whose reason is known; null = any named bots.yml / edge reason. Headers are lower-case request headers in addition to user-agent. https defaults to true. Add a row for every false positive or miss you ever find.
